VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 31 tests pass and provides a plausible root cause and fix, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires "all 31 tests pass," which demands objective verification, not self-attestation.
